mapper.sql: a.id, a.user_id, a.branch_name, a.apply_date, a.talk_date, a.talk_by, a.talk_summary, a.internal_remark, a.status, a.created_by, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.username) AS user_name, u.student_id AS student_no, sp.class_name AS class_name
FROM party_application a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = a.user_id AND sp.deleted = 0

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.student_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.branch_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO party_application (user_id, branch_name, apply_date, talk_date, talk_by, talk_summary, internal_remark, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{branchName}, #{applyDate}, #{talkDate}, #{talkBy}, #{talkSummary}, #{internalRemark}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE party_application SET branch_name = #{application.branchName}, apply_date = #{application.applyDate}, talk_date = #{application.talkDate}, talk_by = #{application.talkBy}, talk_summary = #{application.talkSummary}, internal_remark = #{application.internalRemark}, status = #{application.status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{application.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE party_application SET talk_date = #{talkDate}, talk_by = #{talkBy}, talk_summary = #{talkSummary}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'active' AND talk_date IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT a.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM party_application a WHERE a.deleted = 0 GROUP BY a.status ORDER BY a.status
